question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>θ</mi></math> be the angle between the planes <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>P</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>r</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>·</mo><mfenced><mrow><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>9</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>P</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>r</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>·</mo><mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>15</mn></math>. Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> be the line that meets <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>P</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> at the point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and makes an angle <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>θ</mi></math> with the normal of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>P</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math>. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> is the angle between <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>L</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>P</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><msup><mi>tan</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mfenced><mfenced><mrow><msup><mi>cot</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>α</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to _____ .
